hints.content:
The double number lines show that  a hummingbird can fly $\blueE{13}$ meters in $\maroonD1$ second.


Time (seconds)| Distance (meters)
:-: | :-:
$1$| $13$

The remaining values in the table represent ratios that are equivalent to this ratio.

If the hummingbird flies $3$ times as many meters, it will take $3$ times as many seconds.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A double number line with 3 unequally spaced tick marks. The values in the second number line, labeled Distance (meters), are 13 times the corresponding values in the first number line, labeled Time (seconds). The line labeled Time (seconds), reads from left to right: 0, 1, 3. The line labeled Distance (meters), reads from left to right: 0, 13, 39. An arrow from the pair 1 to 13 to the pair 3 to 39 is labeled times 3.

hints.content:
